conflicts.issue: Mercury broad x86 server CPU unit share cannot represent global all-ISA silicon dollar mix or custom cloud silicon
conflicts.resolution_plan: Constrain to same fiscal period, ISA coverage, units and buyer; hold other denominators unknown

conflicts.issue: AMD Data Center segment combines CPU and GPU revenue; not comparable to CPU-only silicon TAM
conflicts.resolution_plan: Do not promote to CPU-only market series without independently sourced EPYC-only numerator

methods.name: Fixed TAM transfer and conservation
methods.procedure: For scenario/year/workload, retain canonical demand subtotal; allocate only among mutually exclusive qualified CPU silicon economic owners. Set receiving delta = -donor delta, never add demand. Mark unsupported vendor shares null. Separate invoiced merchant sales, captive equivalent and royalty economics.
assumptions: Existing TAM and workload buckets are immutable synthetic inputs
Weights sum to 1 only within an explicitly qualified exclusive allocation frame

methods.name: Evidence-based share-shift signal inference
methods.procedure: Track source vintage, qualification stage, workload, buyer and counterevidence. Order announced, sampled, verified, GA, contracted, delivered and deployed without conflation. Prefer reproducible successful-task TCO and later shipment validation; record falsifiers.
assumptions: Marketing statements are not independent benchmarks
All-ISA unit share and net buyer ASP largely unknown
Future roadmaps have no observed shipment allocation

requirements.outcome: Dashboard overlays competitive allocation while existing demand TAM remains frozen
acceptance_criteria: Do not modify canonical scenario-model.json or historical/forecast CSV
Show unknown shares as null not zero
Prevent allocation double counts; disallow current shipment share for 2028 hardware
Transfer weights sum exactly to zero across donor and recipient

requirements.outcome: Continuously review competitive moves from launch to deployed revenue capture
acceptance_criteria: Every signal has source and date
Qualification states visible and reversible with lineage
No unreviewed packet input displayed as observed market data

handoff.summary: Conditional competitor-capture overlay on fixed existing CPU silicon TAM. Multi-provider moves are staged evidence; no numeric market share promoted.
next_actions: P0 matched task TCO benchmark and all-ISA share crosswalk
P0 future entrant commercial phase tracking
changed_decisions: Treat Arm architecture, Arm CPU silicon, royalties and captive cloud savings as separate nonadditive economics
Treat NVIDIA bundled host CPU supplier as independent competitive control point
limits: No audited global all-ISA vendor CPU silicon share
No validated agent runtime benchmark or commercial transfer price
